name: Kibo UI
summary: Free MIT composable blocks and components designed for shadcn/ui.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 41 registry:ui items — not a full inventory.
Requires existing shadcn/ui (CSS Variables mode) before kibo-ui CLI.
Import path after CLI: @/components/kibo-ui/{slug}; also supports shadcn CLI per docs.
Some comps pull extra registryDependencies (avatar, button, carousel, hover-card, progress).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Marquee
components.summary: Horizontal scrolling marquee built on react-fast-marquee.
components.copyCode:
npx kibo-ui add marquee

import { Marquee, MarqueeContent, MarqueeItem } from "@/components/kibo-ui/marquee"

<Marquee />

copyPrompt.text: Use Kibo UI free component `Marquee` (slug `marquee`) from https://www.kibo-ui.com/components/marquee. Install with `npx kibo-ui add marquee` after shadcn init (CSS variables mode). Registry item: https://www.kibo-ui.com/r/marquee.json. Imports land under `@/components/kibo-ui/marquee`. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui; peers: react-fast-marquee. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shadcnblocks/kibo/main/license.md). Pricing free — open source forever.
